mapper.select: INSERT INTO invoice ( user_id, doc_type, doc_no, source_quote_id, title, content, supply_amount, vat_amount, total_amount, paid ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{docType}, #{docNo}, #{sourceQuoteId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{title}, CAST(#{content} AS jsonb), #{supply}, #{vat}, #{total}, FALSE ) RETURNING id
